description: This file defines utility functions related to console creation, string encoding conversion, and command line argument retrieval, specific to the Windows platform in a Flutter project.

methods.name: CreateAndAttachConsole
methods.description: Creates a console window for the process and redirects stdout and stderr to it for both the runner and the Flutter library.

methods.name: Utf8FromUtf16
methods.description: Converts a null-terminated wchar_t* encoded in UTF-16 to a std::string encoded in UTF-8. Returns an empty string on failure.

methods.name: GetCommandLineArguments
methods.description: Retrieves command line arguments as a vector of UTF-8 encoded strings. Returns an empty vector on failure.
